evidence.evidence_text: In this study, we propose multilingual arbitration, which exploits performance variations among multiple models for each language.
Synthetic data has driven recent state-of-the-art advancements, but reliance on a single oracle teacher model can lead to model collapse and bias propagation.
These issues are particularly severe in multilingual settings, where no single model excels across all languages.
